The netlist says P-CH. If we report, we can quote spec and netlist. Impact: ATO valve is switched by T5 instead of T3; main 24V rail is switched by T3. This would make board behave differently from intended (valve switch current rating, high-side rail switch). But is T5 AO3400A mentioned in spec? What about T1/T4 as interlocks? Spec may call them level shifters, but files show float interlocks. The spec earlier says float interlocks. So files correct.
